_comment: Scaffold only — do not use until cloud sync is intentionally enabled.
enableChecklist: Set CLOUD_BACKEND = "supabase" and CLOUD_SYNC_ENABLED = true in src/cloud/config.ts
Create tables: profiles, app_settings, save_metadata, analysis_history, transfer_shortlist
Each table must include id, user_id, updated_at (and deleted_at optional)
Never store full Football Manager save blobs in save_metadata
